classification: SOURCE-ONLY capacity diagnostic on already observed legacy responses; no new condition outcomes

examples.interpretation: Neither raw anchor reaches delivered context; a delivered-anchor-only continuation cannot act. Even the ten-line source suffix costs more than unused characters plus contained-child savings. Dense has no corresponding raw urlopen window.

The only two development condition rows gaining union activation beyond existing nested containment are the same query and unrelated adjacent module aliases; they are not same-definition complementary windows.

methodology.source_validation: All source hashes checked against original manifests; emitted snippets and transient canonical AST definition keys were read from source only. No selector, postprocessor, index, model or retrieval was called.
methodology.geometry: Inspect actual delivered physical spans. On one path, form connected components using overlap or immediate adjacency. Verify equal bytes on every shared physical line; count literal source-line union and row/character savings. Classify same canonical definition, nested definitions, or distinct adjacent definitions separately.
methodology.continuation: For each delivered definition longer than 160 physical rows, inspect already saved raw-ranked and inventory windows of the same exact definition. A different forward companion must begin at or before actual end+1 and end later. Count availability, novel characters and whether the whole suffix or first new physical line can fit current spare characters plus all literal existing-span union savings. A clipped row remainder from the same canonical window is counted separately. These capacity counts include all delivered origins and do not apply a proposed selector eligibility predicate; they are upper bounds, not activation counts.
methodology.tokens: Unused tokens are the actual saved 4096 minus exact original compact counts. No altered response was built or token-scored. Character-fit counts are upper bounds before extra metadata/token costs.
methodology.independence: The 365 condition rows share 187 query units; repeated studies/orders are not new queries. All corpora here, including urllib3, were already observed development data.

limits: Source capacity is not evidence quality, coding correctness, token savings or native latency.
No new complementary-window selector or postprocessor outcome was computed.
Existing-span union adds no source; source-only prepacking and guarded continuation remain experiments, not conclusions from this diagnostic.
